descriptionMarkdown:
This blueprint is an upcycler designed for Legendary Modules. Since the crafting time is identical for all Legendary Modules, it can easily be adapted for Legendary Efficiency Modules or Legendary Speed Modules.
If you change the module type, you need to adjust *four* things:
1. EMP recipe
2. Train station
3. The module type in the constant combinators (3)
4. The filter of the splitters 

Notes
1. Designed for Vulcanus:
   Recycling Legendary Modules has a chance to return 0-1 Superconductors. Because of this RNG, there is a possibility of running short on superconductors over time.  
   The solution I used is a Constant Combinator + Filter Inserter, which essentially acts as a "void belt". This belt needs to be emptied continuously - on Vulcanus, the excess items are simply dumped into lava.
2. Input balancing:
   The main input is mostly balanced. However, the recycled return flow was not included in the original calculations, which results in a surplus of T2 Modules.
   All assembling machines are fully beaconed with Legendary Speed Modules. The ratios may be more balanced when using common Speed Modules instead.

PS: If you play with biters you may consider safety actions to prevent biter croissants to destroy the factory when producing Legendary Efficiency modules...
title: Legendary Module Upcycler / Train City Block / +- 20/min Legendary Module / Endgame
